title: Vehicle Tracker
description: Online multi-target vehicle tracking model for embedded hardware
long_description: RNN-based online multi-target vehicle tracker implementing Milan et al. 2017 with domain adaptations for CARLA synthetic data. Stage 1: RNN motion model (64 hidden units, 61.5 KB). Stage 2: LSTM data association model (aurix mode, 86.0 KB). Trained on CARLA simulator data (5 vehicle classes, 8 towns, 86,014 annotations). Designed for deployment on AURIX TC4Dx embedded MCU.
kit: TRAVEO™ T2G Body EntryLite Kit KIT_T2G-B-E_LITE
